description: Defines the class 'f1ap_du_ue_manager' which manages UE contexts in the F1AP-DU, including adding, removing, and finding UEs, and maintains mappings between different UE identifiers.

classes.name: f1ap_du_ue_manager
classes.description: Manages UE contexts for F1AP-DU, including adding, removing, and lookup operations, and maintains internal mappings.

methods.name: update_tx_pdu_notifier
methods.description: Sets the notifier for transmission PDUs.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE context with a specified UE index.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE context by UE index.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses UE context by UE index (non-const and const versions).

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds UE context by UE index or by F1AP ID.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE exists by index or F1AP ID.

methods.name: get_ue_index
methods.description: Retrieves UE index from F1AP ID.

methods.name: nof_ues
methods.description: Returns the number of UEs managed.
